name: voxcpm2
label: VoxCPM2 (on this computer)
summary: Free and on this computer: nothing leaves it. Voices are designed from a description or copied from a real person's recording.
recommend: Recommended on an Apple Silicon Mac.
setupNote: The first recording downloads the voice model (about 3.2 GB) into the Hugging Face cache.
needs: VoxCPM2 needs an Apple Silicon Mac and Python 3.12.

sounds.cough: coughing, a short dry cough, no words
sounds.gasp: a sharp surprised gasp, no words
sounds.sigh: a long tired sigh, no words
sounds.yawn: a big sleepy yawn, no words
sounds.scream: a short frightened scream, no words
sounds.hum: humming a little tune, no words
